protocol.bootstrap_generation: null-impose the target in the bounded core-five pilot, preserve the other four fitted coefficients, known initial state and supplied OU covariance
protocol.nominal: unchanged archived standard error and identical point estimate
protocol.design_noise_sandwich: observed fixed-weight GLS bread H=A'WA; model score meat Var(Astar'W mstar), including stochastic polynomial design. Estimate target variance by centered MC influences e14'H^-1 Astar'W mstar under null-imposed pilot, with fixed observed covariance weights; correct deterministic generating-model quadrature defect. This branch holds covariance pilot weights fixed.
protocol.bootstrap: sample SD (ddof=1) of the full estimator target over parametric OU replicates generated from the null-imposed pilot; rebuild the 30-window pilot, ODE trajectory, Hermite covariance, quadrature correction and final 18-coefficient GLS in every replicate

criteria.primary: Wilson 95% interval for null rejection contains 0.05 separately for each method
criteria.wald_test: same observed coefficient / method SE, two-sided z0.975; no bias correction, empirical rejection cutoffs or SE multipliers
criteria.scope: prespecified diagnostic on the same previously evaluated 100 null paths; not independent holdout confirmation
criteria.failures: stop shard and preserve outputs; no silent resample dropping or count changes
criteria.power: no calibrated-power claim until independent validation; no power runs authorized in this diagnostic

numerical_smoke.scope: execution correctness only; not used for calibration conclusions
